metadata.method_name: P1 random-edit panel (GaMS3-12B-Instruct): placebo-controlled EN->SL surrogacy of Heretic edits
metadata.predict_fields: predict_baseline_* = SL half-B trait forecast from EN half-A traits (out-of-fold on F, fitted-on-F for E_TPE/E_R); predict_our_method_* = same + exposure D

R.note: bootstrap draws average A->B and B->A like the point estimate, 1 CV repeat per draw (seed varies by draw), GroupKFold by original edit so duplicated edits never straddle folds

R1.note: bootstrap draws average A->B and B->A like the point estimate, 1 CV repeat per draw (seed varies by draw), GroupKFold by original edit so duplicated edits never straddle folds

N.note: bootstrap draws average A->B and B->A like the point estimate, 1 CV repeat per draw (seed varies by draw), GroupKFold by original edit so duplicated edits never straddle folds

M.note: bootstrap draws average A->B and B->A like the point estimate, 1 CV repeat per draw (seed varies by draw), GroupKFold by original edit so duplicated edits never straddle folds

reselection.method: logistic map of SL R_seq -> judged refusal on validity conditions

validity.label_source: gpt-4.1 where labelled, else local Qwen3-14B (same rubric)

unit_tests.sibling_manifest_diff: no sibling edits manifest readable at stage0b time

chosen_desc: full S3 (JBB 85 twins, Dolly 100, FLORES 200, MC 120)
ladder_decision.rule: first ladder step with t_edit(step) * N_remaining <= (remaining - 65 min - 10 min) * 0.85; frozen BEFORE any trait is analysed; re-timing every 25 edits may only cut the tail edit count, never the item set

judge_meta.note: judge sees only request + reply under a shuffled neutral id; model/edit/condition hidden

local_judge.model: Qwen/Qwen3-14B@40c06982 (bnb_4bit NF4), same rubric, prefill '{"label": "', argmax of label first-token log-probs
local_judge.role: second judge (replaces gemini-2.5-flash, blocked by the run-level budget and the exhausted free tier) + fill-in for generations without a gpt-4.1 label
local_judge.family_note: Qwen3 differs in family from GaMS3 (Gemma-3 based) and from gpt-4.1; it replaces the planned gemini-2.5-flash (budget-blocked)

deviations.what: GPU = RTX 4090 24 GB for Stages 0-B and the whole panel (plan: A4500 20 GB); the post-panel steps (local judge, post_tests, repro_check, final analysis) ran on host 3 = RTX 2000 Ada 16 GB after a second server restart (see D20)
deviations.impact: panel: faster, nothing else changes; host 3 only re-scores 3 edits for the reproducibility check

deviations.what: OpenRouter key HTTP 403 (shared $50 daily limit) at the Stage -1 probe (21:05 UTC)
deviations.fallback: F1: references chosen with the EXP3 rule labeller (references.json meta label_source=rule_labelled); gpt-4.1 judging deferred to after the 00:00 UTC reset; X_SET translated with NLLB-200-distilled-1.3B (F11) instead of gemini-2.5-flash
deviations.impact: reference choice may differ from judge-based choice; the disagreement count is reported after judging

deviations.what: r_prior status decided with rule labels (pooled 23 benign half-A refusals: EN 9, SL 14 >= 10) -> r_prior DEFINED and P computed; G5 predicted undefined
deviations.impact: keyword rule over-counts refusals ('illegal', 'harmful' in compliant text); judge-based recount reported in r_prior_status after judging; P treated as exploratory

deviations.what: U7 batching certification FAILED: left-padded batched greedy generation token-identical on only 5/8 (EN) and 7/8 (SL) prompts; teacher-forced right-padded batched vs batch-size-1 max |dlogp| 0.18 / 0.12 nats (> 0.02)
deviations.fallback: generation switched automatically to equal-length buckets (no padding) for ALL generations; teacher-forced batching kept (deterministic batch composition, identical across edits) and diagnosed in post_tests.json (U7_diagnostic: unpadded same-length batches vs bs1)
deviations.impact: item-level numerical noise of ~0.01 nats enters every trait; it is absorbed by the split-half ceilings

deviations.what: U6 FLORES NLL cross-check vs EXP3 C0: mean |diff| 0.009, max 0.035 nats (tolerance 2e-3 FAILED)
deviations.impact: EXP3 used its own eager-attention 4-bit load and different batch shapes; same magnitude as D4 numerics; N (FLORES rise) edit effects are of the same order, see F8 no-signal rule

deviations.what: U4 and U5 were run after the panel (post_tests.py, second model instance) instead of in stage0b
deviations.impact: none on the panel (they validate formulas/approximations, not inputs)

deviations.what: Winsorization implemented per vector (|x| 0.995-quantile clip over dims, Heretic/EXP3 semantics) rather than 'per-dim pooled quantiles'
deviations.impact: tames dim 2339 as intended; w_H cos with EXP3 frozen d_EN = 0.99997

deviations.what: Bootstrap draws use one CV repeat per draw (seed varies) and GroupKFold by original edit index (duplicated edits never straddle folds); point estimates use 5 repeats
deviations.impact: repeat noise enters the bootstrap spread (conservative); the grouped CV fixes a leak found by synth_test scenario (b) where plain KFold on resampled edits shrank the bootstrap Gap

deviations.what: Validity generations are 64 tokens, bucketed decoding (~110 s per validity edit)
deviations.impact: none on design

deviations.what: P covariate layer = hidden index 34 (the frozen H probe layer)
deviations.impact: r_prior is computed at every layer but P only at 34

deviations.what: 30-local-draw augmentation for the core forecast not run (as allowed by the plan)
deviations.impact: core excess uses the global forecast / GP if out of support

deviations.what: F8 no-signal rule operationalised with the edit x item interaction SE (item means removed) as the per-edit item SE; the first implementation used the raw between-item SD
deviations.why: a debug run on 43 edits (outputs not used for decisions) showed the raw version flags R as 'no signal' although its split-half reliability is 1.0 - fixed item offsets cancel in between-edit comparisons, so raw between-item SD is not measurement noise
deviations.impact: both versions are reported (no_signal and no_signal_raw_version); the verdict uses the interaction version

deviations.what: Carrier bootstrap CIs resample edits over FIXED out-of-fold predictions (5 repeats averaged) instead of refitting CV inside each draw; 1000 draws
deviations.why: refitting at n~43 gave unstable intervals of +/-10 in R2 units in the debug run
deviations.impact: CIs reflect edit sampling of prediction errors, not refit variance

deviations.what: SUPERSEDED: the rehearsal analysis used B = 500 (fallback) on a shared CPU; the FINAL analysis ran with the frozen B = 1000 on a 48-core host (bootstrap of 500 took ~64 s, far below the 30-min fallback trigger)
deviations.impact: none: the final CIs use the frozen B = 1000

deviations.what: Mixed model d_ie ~ EN_trait x margin + lang + lang:EN_trait + (1|item) + (1|edit) IS run (analysis.mixed_model, statsmodels MixedLM with crossed variance components) on the R and M traits, half-B items, F edits
deviations.impact: p-values treat item x edit x language rows as the unit and are descriptive; the joint bootstrap is the inferential tool

deviations.what: Session interrupted at 22:38 UTC after 51/246 panel edits (E0_000..E0_050, host 1: Ryzen 9 7950X + RTX 4090); the panel resumed at 22:52 UTC on a different container (host 2: EPYC 7352 + RTX 4090, same driver family) from E0_051, via the append-only resume path (edits already in panel_edits.jsonl are skipped; no edit was scored twice). The panel's time guard was extended with P1_TOTAL_BUDGET_S=27600 s from the original start (20:59 UTC) because the restarted session has its own budget
deviations.check: repro_check.py re-scores two host-1 edits (E0_000, E0_049) and one host-2 edit (E0_051) after the panel and compares every per-item value to the stored parquet (results/repro_check.json)
deviations.impact: if host-1 vs host-2 values differ, the difference is GPU-kernel numerics (same GPU model); its magnitude is reported next to the item-level noise
deviations.outcome: repro_check.py ran on host 3 (RTX 2000 Ada) after a further restart, so it measures cross-GPU-model numerics: All teacher-forced traits re-score within bf16/NF4 numerics on a different GPU (RTX 2000 Ada vs RTX 4090): R_seq max |diff| <= 0.041, K-KL <= 0.0021, FLORES NLL <= 0.12, MC margin <= 0.14, R1 <= 0.25 (first-token log-odds). Hproj/Pproj are raw residual projections at hidden layer 34 (magnitude ~2000-3000); their mean |diff| is <1% of the stored per-item SD, so the H/P covariates are unaffected at the scale they vary across edits. No row is bit-identical across GPUs. Exception: the per-item truncated KL of these three WEAK edits (stored mean KL E0_000 0.0014, E0_049 0.0012, E0_051 0.0022 nats) moves by a mean |diff| of 0.00032, 0.00030, 0.00037 (17-26% of the mean KL; 0.29-0.56 of the per-item SD) across GPUs, because the original-model reference continuation distribution was cached on host 1: K = log mean KL therefore can shift by up to ~0.2-0.3 log-units for the weakest edits across GPUs (less if item-level differences cancel; signed diffs were not saved). All panel edits were scored on RTX 4090s (hosts 1 and 2); host 3 only re-scored. host_check.py then tested host 1 vs host 2 directly on the panel: max |host-2 offset| = 0.071 log units vs residual SD ~0.45: no detectable host offset in K between the two RTX 4090 hosts

deviations.what: judge.py originally posted to a hard-coded openrouter.ai URL; fixed to os.environ['OPENROUTER_BASE_URL'] before any judging call. Stage -1 probe of the previous session was a direct curl to openrouter.ai (403, $0)
deviations.impact: none on results (no call succeeded before the fix)

deviations.what: Static baseline b2 = kernel-weighted |cos(v_l, lang_l)| uses Heretic's interpolated refusal direction BEFORE the per-layer harmless-mean orthogonalization (plan: after it); b1 uses the per-layer EN/SL diff-in-means cosine as planned
deviations.impact: b2 is one of 13 S0 features; the orthogonalization removes a component along the harmless mean, which is not the language direction, so the ranking of edits on b2 is expected to change little

deviations.what: Added after the freeze (exploratory, labelled so everywhere): EN->SL transfer slopes/attenuation ratio (analysis.transfer_slopes), quantile-GBT PI coverage, core log-ratio excess, judge re-checks of the rule-labelled references and r_prior, predictions scorecard, cross-pod edit identity check (unit_tests.json U1b_sibling_diff)
deviations.impact: none on the frozen decision rules; they add interpretation (Gap ~ 0 means 'predictable', not 'equal size')

deviations.what: Second server restart (~02:57 UTC) moved the module to host 3 (RTX 2000 Ada 16 GB, empty model cache, .venv removed). The .venv was rebuilt from pyproject.toml (identical pins) and the models re-downloaded at the pinned revisions (GaMS3 main == 1d0b27af verified via the Hub API). The planned local gemma-3-12b-it fill-in judge had been interrupted at 409/2140 by the restart and saved nothing.
deviations.fallback: The OpenRouter run budget was still exhausted (403 aii_run_budget_exhausted, $7.05 of $7.00 for the whole 'Test idea' phase, shared by all pods) and the org's free-model daily quota (1000/day) was also used up, so the second judge and the fill-in for the 1010 unlabelled generations use a LOCAL Qwen/Qwen3-14B@40c06982 (bnb_4bit, same rubric and user message, thinking disabled, label = argmax of the six label first-token log-probs). Qwen3 is a different family from GaMS3/Gemma-3 and from gpt-4.1.
deviations.check: Agreement with gpt-4.1 on all 1130 generations both judged: kappa refused-vs-not 0.875 (EN 0.919, SL 0.831), 6-way kappa 0.702, raw refused agreement 0.951 (results/judge_meta.json local_judge). The validity gate is reported for merged labels (primary), gpt-4.1-only, local-only and rule labels.
deviations.impact: 9 of the 18 validity conditions (E1_010..E1_090) are labelled only by the local judge; ~20 of 80 generations in each of the other 9 conditions are local-labelled. The planned cross-family API second judge (gemini-2.5-flash) and its 200-row stratified kappa were NOT run; the local-judge kappa over 1130 rows stands in for it.
deviations.post_tests: post_tests.py ran on host 3: U4 formula-vs-PEFT max rel diff 1.9e-7 (PASS); U5 truncated/full KL ratio 1.026 (PASS, >= 0.95; the truncated reference was cached on host 1 and the full one recomputed on host 3, so cross-GPU noise enters the ratio); U7 diagnostic: unpadded same-length batches differ from batch size 1 by the same magnitude as padded batches (max 0.27 vs 0.28 nats; per-sequence mean NLL <= 0.049), and a repeated batched pass is bit-identical -> batch-shape numerics, not an attention-mask error

R.note: ENt and margin standardized; lang = 1 for SL; lang:ENt < 0 means SL item changes track the EN edit trait less than EN item changes do, after item/edit random intercepts and the baseline margin

M.note: ENt and margin standardized; lang = 1 for SL; lang:ENt < 0 means SL item changes track the EN edit trait less than EN item changes do, after item/edit random intercepts and the baseline margin

transfer_slopes.status: exploratory (post-freeze addition; distinguishes 'SL unpredictable' (Gap) from 'SL attenuated' (ratio < 1))

source_carrier.status: exploratory (post-freeze; hypothesis generated on this panel - needs an independent panel to confirm)

k_ratio_carriers.y: log(mean KL_trunc SL_B / mean KL_trunc EN_B)
k_ratio_carriers.status: exploratory (post-freeze; SRC hypothesis generated on this panel via fig8 / param attribution)

U4_realized_vs_cached_core.note: cached exposure uses ORIGINAL-model module inputs; the realized value uses the edited model's own inputs (upstream edits shift them), so equality is not expected - ratio reported

U5_truncated_vs_full_KL.note: truncated reference from the stage0d cache (batched); full reference recomputed here (different batch shapes add bf16 noise to both)

U7_diagnostic.interpretation: if unpadded same-length batches differ from batch size 1 by the same magnitude as padded batches, the difference is batch-shape numerics (bf16 / NF4 GEMM tiling), not an attention-mask error

Hproj/Pproj are raw residual projections at hidden layer 34 (magnitude ~2000-3000); their mean |diff| is <1% of the stored per-item SD, so the H/P covariates are unaffected at the scale they vary across edits. No row is bit-identical across GPUs. Exception: the per-item truncated KL of these three WEAK edits (stored mean KL E0_000 0.0014, E0_049 0.0012, E0_051 0.0022 nats) moves by a mean |diff| of 0.00032, 0.00030, 0.00037 (17-26% of the mean KL; 0.29-0.56 of the per-item SD) across GPUs, because the original-model reference continuation distribution was cached on host 1: K = log mean KL therefore can shift by up to ~0.2-0.3 log-units for the weakest edits across GPUs (less if item-level differences cancel; signed diffs were not saved). All panel edits were scored on RTX 4090s (hosts 1 and 2); host 3 only re-scored.

host1_vs_host2_K_offset_check.method: OLS of log KL_<lang> on [1, log lora_fro, log lora_fro^2, host2] (host 1 = E0_000..E0_050, host 2 = the rest; both RTX 4090)
host1_vs_host2_K_offset_check.conclusion: max |host-2 offset| = 0.071 log units vs residual SD ~0.45: no detectable host offset in K between the two RTX 4090 hosts

rederive_headlines.learners: ExtraTrees(300, leaf 3, 10-fold) and numpy LOO quadratic ridge (lambda 1)
rederive_headlines.note: predictors = EN R, R1, Rb, K of the source half (N, M omitted: F8 no-signal); primary analysis used all six + HistGBT

u6_flores_check.note: our batched right-padded FLORES NLL (Heretic PeftModel, zeroed LoRA) vs EXP3 C0 per-item NLL (own 4-bit load, eager attention) on the shared half-B ids
